description: Choose which Merchant Center account a feed uses. Required when get_merchant_link lists more than one account. Pass connectionId and accountId from that result, plus feedId. The account must be one Google actually showed for this connection. Owner only. Does not write a feed or a data source to Google.

accountId.description: Merchant Center account id from get_merchant_link.

feedId.description: Feed that should read this Merchant Center account.

name: select_merchant_account
title: Choose Merchant Center account
